dct_description_sm: This is a data schema created using Agri-food Data Canada's Semantic Engine . Data schemas describe data that are collected on an ongoing basis from research centres, and provide add-on documentation that enhances the value of raw data. This schema describes data collected from records of reproductive events entered on DairyComp Herd Management Software. This schema is designed to systematically record and organize data about reproductive events, such as breedings, pregnancies, calvings, and any related interventions and allows for the integration of reproductive data with other information in the DairyComp Herd Management Software such as health records, milk production, and herd management data. Data described in this schema is sample data, to request access to the related data, please visit the Ontario Dairy Research Centre Data Portal.
